name: 5289-longprompt-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, one in-process vLLM engine driven by guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 30%, bounded at 640 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, 4096 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens per request, 640 requests, single turn, static seed 5289. Decoding is the engine's own defaults -- the declaration carries no `sampling_params` block.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing long reports for 64 concurrent users on a single GPU with an eight-billion-parameter model.
launch:
# ENGINE: 828da0d44e9124d949909477d6018fc08469a31e -- `git describe --tags` says
# v0.4.3-56-g828da0d44e912 (2024-06-06). Every key here becomes an `AsyncEngineArgs(**kwargs)`
# keyword and this is a June-2024 engine: an unknown key is a TypeError at construction, not a
# no-op. Do not add keys from a later vLLM (no compilation_config, speculative_config,
# kv_transfer_config or async_scheduling).
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
